name: bada-ultranetwork
description: Bada UltraNetwork — the house mains wiring becomes the physical layer via Panasonic HD-PLC (IEEE 1901 wavelet OFDM with a Zimmermann-Dostert channel model and adaptive PAM bit loading); frames are mapped onto an NTT subscriber line by an injective, registry-backed numbering map with a voiceband 16-QAM soft modem, G.711 mu-law/RTP or an ISDN B channel as the bearer; they carry the zone://url.or.jp ultra-network WWW over a P2P ring DHT with no DNS root; the payload is sealed with the Jones-polynomial quantum cipher (Kauffman-bracket knot key, Bell-pair QKD, AEAD); and what is carried are LINE Messaging API and Instagram Graph API messages in one unified inbox. Organised as an AT&T Bell Labs STREAMS stack. Self-contained HTML app.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
